style: A crisp, high fidelity, pixel perfect screenshot of a professional native macOS 3D CAD application called ViaForm, straight-on flat screenshot, no device frame, no perspective, no hands, no desk. Visual language: a very clean, airy, light Apple-style interface in the spirit of modern touch-first CAD apps. The 3D viewport fills the entire window edge to edge (full bleed) with a soft light grey gradient background (#F4F5F7 to #E6E8EC) and a faint infinite ground grid. All panels FLOAT over the viewport as rounded cards (corner radius 14 px) in frosted white translucent material with very soft shadows, leaving 12 to 16 px of viewport visible around them. Generous spacing, few controls, nothing dense. Typography: San Francisco (SF Pro) only, dark grey #1D1D1F text, secondary text #8E8E93, sizes 12 to 13 pt, medium weight for titles. One accent colour: ViaForm indigo blue #4F5BD5 for selection, active tool and primary buttons; selected 3D geometry is highlighted in that same indigo with a thin glow. Icons are small monochrome dark grey line glyphs. macOS window chrome: red, yellow, green traffic lights at the top left of a slim unified title bar that is itself translucent over the viewport; in the title bar left: document title, then undo and redo. In the CENTRE of the title bar: a segmented control with eight segments, reading exactly: Design | Generative | Mechanics | Electronics | Simulation | Training | Render | Manufacture, the active one shown as a white raised pill. Title bar right: a search field reading 'Search commands  ⌘K', a share button, a small round avatar. Every visible text label must be short, real, correctly spelled English. No brand names or logos other than ViaForm. No lorem ipsum, no gibberish, no watermark. Keep text sparse and large enough to read.
1-design: Active segment: Design. Title bar document title: 'Robotic Hand v3'. Viewport centre: a detailed humanoid robotic hand assembly in a three-quarter view, palm facing the viewer at an angle, five articulated fingers made of smooth organic generative lattice-like matte white and graphite parts, small cylindrical brushless motors visible at each finger joint (knuckle, middle and tip joints), tendon pulleys, an aluminium wrist mount. The index finger middle phalanx is selected, highlighted in indigo #4F5BD5. Left edge: a slim vertical floating tool rail, a narrow pill 52 px wide with about 9 single icons stacked (select, sketch line, rectangle, extrude, fillet, move, joint, measure, section), one active in indigo. Right side: a floating sidebar card 280 px wide with a small two-segment switch at its top reading 'Items | History', Items active, showing a clean list with eye toggles: 'Palm', 'Thumb', 'Index finger' expanded with 'Proximal', 'Middle' (selected row with indigo background), 'Distal', then 'Middle finger', 'Ring finger', 'Little finger', 'Wrist mount', 'Motors (15)'. Below the list a small properties block: 'Middle phalanx', 'Material  Ti-6Al-4V', 'Mass  4.2 g', 'Joint  Revolute, 0 to 95 deg', 'Motor  M2 micro BLDC'. Floating contextual menu: a horizontal rounded pill just above the selected phalanx in the viewport, with 5 icon+label items: 'Fillet', 'Shell', 'Move', 'Joint', 'Regenerate', plus a small inline value field showing '2.0 mm'. Top right of viewport under the title bar: a small view cube. Bottom centre: a tiny floating pill with orbit, pan, zoom, fit icons. Bottom left: a small axis triad. Lots of empty light space around the hand.
2-generative: Active segment: Generative. Title bar document title: 'Racer 3in Frame'. Viewport centre-left: a 3-inch FPV drone quadcopter X frame produced by topology optimisation, organic bone-like branching arms, shown with a smooth stress colour map from blue (low) through green and yellow to red (high) concentrated at the arm roots, four motor mount rings at the arm tips, small arrows showing load cases: a downward red arrow labelled 'Crash 12 g', upward blue arrows on motor mounts labelled 'Thrust 4 x 380 g'. Next to the model a slim vertical colour scale legend reading '0 MPa' at the bottom and '182 MPa' at the top. Left edge: the slim floating tool rail pill with about 7 icons (preserve region, obstacle, load, constraint, objective, generate, compare), 'load' active in indigo. Right side: floating sidebar card titled 'Study 2', with sections 'Load cases': 'Crash 12 g', 'Full thrust', 'Hover gust'; 'Objectives': 'Minimise mass', 'Safety factor 2.0'; 'Material': 'Carbon nylon'; a progress bar 'Generating 74 of 120'. Bottom: a floating horizontal gallery strip card titled 'Variants' with 6 small rounded thumbnails of different organic drone frame variants on white, each with a tiny caption like '#14  11.6 g', '#31  12.3 g', '#52  13.1 g', '#67  12.9 g', '#71  12.4 g', '#73  12.8 g', the first thumbnail outlined in indigo. Floating contextual pill above the frame: 'Use as Frame', 'Compare', 'Refine'. Small view cube top right.
3-simulation: Active segment: Simulation. Title bar document title: 'Racer 3in Flight'. Here the full-bleed viewport is a bright, clean simulated outdoor scene: soft daylight, pale sky, a flat light grey ground plane with a fine grid, a racing obstacle course of 5 square gates in soft orange and two tall poles, a small 3-inch FPV quadcopter drone in mid flight banking through the third gate, a thin indigo flight path trail curving through the previous gates and a dashed line toward the next ones, a few faint white wind streamlines blowing from left to right with a small floating badge 'Wind 6 m/s'. Left edge: slim floating tool rail pill with about 6 icons (play, step, camera, wind, gates, record), 'play' active in indigo. Top left of viewport: a small floating card 'Run 12  Obstacle course' with a play/pause button and a time scrubber at 19.7 s. Right side: a floating sidebar card titled 'Telemetry' with three small clean line charts stacked, each with a title and a thin line: 'Altitude  1.69 m', 'Speed  7.4 m/s', 'Motor RPM' (four thin coloured lines), and below a compact list 'Gates  3 of 5', 'Battery  14.8 V', 'Controller  PID v4'. Floating contextual pill next to the drone: 'Follow', 'Stress here', 'Re-run'. Bottom centre: a floating pill with 'Wind' slider and 'Gusts' toggle. Light and airy, not dark.
4-electronics: Active segment: Electronics. Title bar document title: 'Flight Controller rev 196'. Full-bleed viewport on a pale light grey background shows a large square 30.5 mm drone flight controller PCB seen straight from above in 2D layout view: deep green solder mask, four mounting holes in the corners with gold rings, a central square microcontroller chip labelled 'U1', a smaller IMU chip labelled 'U2', copper traces in red (top layer) and blue (bottom layer) neatly routed at 45 degree angles, small SMD capacitors and resistors, white silkscreen reference labels, a few gold edge pads. One trace net is highlighted in indigo. Left edge: slim floating tool rail pill with about 7 icons (select, route, via, place, pour, measure, check). 'route' active. Top right floating card: a small 3D preview titled 'In Frame v8' showing the same green board mounted in the centre of a black carbon drone frame in three-quarter view, with a small button 'Show in 3D'. Right side below it: floating sidebar card with switch 'Items | History', Items list: 'Schematic', 'Power  5V 3V3', 'MCU', 'IMU', 'ESC 4 in 1', 'Layers' expanded with small colour chips 'Top', 'Inner 1', 'Inner 2', 'Bottom', 'Silk'; and 'DRC  0 errors' with a green check. Floating contextual pill near the highlighted trace: 'Route', 'Width 0.2 mm', 'Via', 'Re-check clearance'. Clean, generous, light.
5-ipad: This one is an iPad Pro landscape app screenshot, iPadOS, no macOS traffic lights and no menu bar: a thin iPadOS status bar at the very top (time '9:41' at left, battery at right), then a slim floating top bar: left a sidebar toggle and document title 'Robotic Hand v3', centre the same eight-segment control 'Design | Generative | Mechanics | Electronics | Simulation | Training | Render | Manufacture' with Design active, right: undo, redo, 'Items' and 'History' toggle buttons. Larger touch targets (44 pt), even more generous spacing than the Mac. Full-bleed light viewport with the humanoid robotic hand assembly: five articulated fingers of smooth organic matte white and graphite parts, small cylindrical motors at each finger joint, wrist mount; the thumb distal face selected in indigo #4F5BD5 with a round drag handle arrow and a floating value bubble '12.0 mm'. Left edge: a floating vertical tool panel with large rounded square tool buttons in two groups separated by a gap: sketch tools (line, arc, rectangle, circle) then solid tools (extrude, fillet, chamfer, move, joint). Near the selection a floating suggestion pill with large items: 'Extrude', 'Offset', 'Sketch on face', 'Fillet'. Right side: a floating Items card with bigger rows and eye and lock icons: 'Palm', 'Thumb' (selected), 'Index finger', 'Middle finger', 'Ring finger', 'Little finger', 'Wrist mount'. A stylus pencil tip drawn faintly near the drag handle is NOT shown: no hands, no pencil, just the interface. Small view cube top right.
